APPROVE
`Lex` now scores roughly 7–8 because each branch delegates to a helper, and I traced every path against the original (comment ends, prefix and verbatim scanning, raw-literal fences, escape handling and the unterminated-literal clamp) with identical results; the helpers type-check, though I couldn't build it here, so a clean compile assumes nullable reference types are enabled and none of the new helper names already exist elsewhere in the partial class.
